# board_sim example-matrix baseline -- see scripts/checks/matrix_ratchet.py
#
# Recorded debt from `bash scripts/sim/matrix.sh`, one
# `app<TAB>verdict<TAB>cause` row each. This is a RATCHET: growth fails,
# shrinking is free, and the end state is an EMPTY file. It is not an
# allowlist -- no row here is a permanent exemption, and every one is work
# still owed. The cause column is not decoration: a number nobody can
# explain is indistinguishable from one nobody has looked at.
#
# MEASURE THIS ON THE CI RUNNER, NEVER ON A DEVELOPER BOX. The two disagree
# by more than the tolerance of this gate -- the whole ThreadX family faults
# on the shared dev box while the same commit is green on the runner (#400).
# A baseline taken there would record ~40 CI-clean apps as expected-to-fail,
# and because a ratchet only objects to GROWTH, every one could then break for
# real without the gate noticing. That is baseline-as-grandfather, which is
# the thing this design refuses to be.
#
# Seeded from the verified-clean CI run at 0522f9930: 204 ek_ra8d2 examples,
# 202 booted OK, 0 build failures, 0 truncations, 99% of runnable, with
# sil-integration green on the same commit.
#
# Re-baseline after burning debt down (causes are carried forward):
#   bash scripts/sim/matrix.sh; python3 scripts/checks/matrix_ratchet.py --update
# total: 5
import_reader	FAULT	reaches 'card ready' + 'volume mounted', then 'FAIL import compile' and traps; wants a pre-populated library card (cf. sd_font_render's baked FONT.OTF image)
ota_ab_orchestration	FAULT	stages A/B images into the extra-MRAM (data-flash) bank at 0x27000000 (#397), a region absent from the RA8D2 manual; board_sim narrowed to real silicon now faults there as the bench does (J-Link w4 answers "Failed to write memory", MSTATR=0x0080C000); off the baseline when #397 repoints the extra-MRAM constant
ra8_ftl_demo	FAULT	the ra8_ftl backend writes its wear-level blocks to the extra-MRAM (data-flash) window at 0x27000000 (#397), which this part does not decode; board_sim now leaves 0x27000000 unmapped to match silicon and faults there; off the baseline when #397 repoints the extra-MRAM constant
ra8_io_mram_demo	FAULT	erases/programs the extra MRAM at nonexistent 0x27000000 (#397); the bench MACI rejects it (MSTATR=0x0080C000, MASTAT=0x18); board_sim now unmaps 0x27000000 and faults there matching silicon; off the baseline when #397 repoints the extra-MRAM constant
secure_boot_ns_hil	FAULT	board_sim --ns loader gap (#404): the .ns_bss zeroing loop faults at 0x32100052 because the literal at 0x3210006c reads as zero -- the NS image tail is not populated
